summary: Iter918 — Full verification of (1) SEO post-processor injection on production preview + (2) Pre-Production Entitlement Lock flipped OFF. All SEO acceptance criteria pass via raw curl (server-side HTML): /features/travel-visa has correct <title>, canonical, og:title/description/url/image + twitter:card summary_large_image; /welcome has 'RealAICoach — Elevate Your Professional Trajectory' + full OG card; / (root), /features/fitness ('Fitness Coach | RealAICoach'), /features/pennypilot ('PennyPilot Finance | RealAICoach') all have their unique per-page titles + OG tags. /sitemap.xml=200 valid XML with 45 URLs (0 /admin, 0 /auth entries). /robots.txt=200 with Cloudflare-managed content-signal block + custom 'Disallow: /admin', 'Disallow: /auth', 'Disallow: /api', 'Sitemap:' line. /og-image.png=200 image/png 986KB. Admin pages are correctly excluded from the sitemap. LOCK OFF verified: admin GET /api/platform-control/entitlement-lock returns {active:false, env_default:false}. Admin /api/auth/me is_admin=true plan=premium; free user is_admin=false plan=free (lock-off did not grant plans). Free user POST /api/subscriptions/create-checkout for both basic and premium returns HTTP 200 with real Stripe LIVE checkout URLs (cs_live_a18e7c... / cs_live_a1yRiu...) — URLs verified, NO payment attempted. Subscription-gated feature endpoints (/api/ai-copywriter/generate, /api/watch-videos/premium/list, /api/travel-planner/premium-features, /api/revenue/upgrade) now return the normal 403 upsell 'This feature requires a Basic plan or higher. Upgrade now to unlock access.' — the 'Subscriptions are disabled until production launch.' message is completely GONE. /api/health=200 healthy. UI: /welcome renders hero, /auth/login renders form with email/password/SSO/passkey. Updated /app/backend/tests/test_preprod_entitlement_lock.py to be lock-state-aware (reads GET entitlement-lock at module setup and branches assertions accordingly) — 14 passed, 2 skipped (former-premium & DB integrity tests correctly skip when lock is OFF). Toggle round-trip test flips opposite→restores original in a try/finally so lock state is never permanently changed. Lock confirmed still OFF after full suite run.
critical_code_review_comments: scripts/seo.js correctly SKIPS admin/, auth/, (tabs), +not-found, _sitemap, api prefixes when walking server/*.html — verified via manual sitemap grep (0 /admin, 0 /auth) and confirmed admin/security HTML retains only the default RNW-shell head tags (no SEO override).

scripts/seo.js DEFAULT_DESC and PAGES map are hardcoded — acceptable for the current 45 public routes; recommend extracting to /app/frontend/scripts/seo-metadata.json if the list grows past ~60 entries to keep seo.js under 200 LoC.
seo.js readEnvBaseUrl falls back to https://realaicoach.app if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is missing from /app/frontend/.env — safe fallback for CI builds that don't have preview env vars.
seo.js correctly deletes stale .br/.gz precompressed variants after modifying HTML (lines 121-124) — critical so Cloudflare/nginx serves the new HTML with injected tags, not the old compressed cache.
test_preprod_entitlement_lock.py rewrite uses a module-scoped `lock_state` fixture so lock-branching tests share one GET; toggle round-trip is wrapped in try/finally to guarantee state restoration.

Robots.txt has BOTH a Cloudflare-managed content-signal block (search=yes, ai-train=no) AND the seo.js-generated 'User-agent: *
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /auth
Disallow: /api
Sitemap:' block — the second block appended after the Cloudflare block. Some robots.txt parsers only honor the FIRST 'User-agent: *' group; recommend verifying with Google Search Console robots tester that /admin, /auth, /api are actually blocked. Not blocking release.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Pre-Prod Entitlement Lock is now OFF (backend/.env PREPROD_ENTITLEMENT_LOCK=false + DB platform_entitlement_lock.active=false). Free users CAN now hit /api/subscriptions/create-checkout and get real Stripe LIVE checkout URLs — NEVER complete a payment during tests; only verify checkout_url starts with 'https://checkout.stripe.com/'. Stripe is in LIVE mode. Subscription-gated feature endpoints return the standard upsell body {error:'Subscription Required', message:'This feature requires a Basic plan or higher.', current_plan:'free', required_plan:'basic', upgrade_url:'/subscription/plans'}. The preprod-lock detail string 'Subscriptions are disabled until production launch.' is now expected to be ABSENT from all responses. Non-admin users (including formerly-premium 'watchvideos.premium.4dc6ab84') still resolve to plan='free' via /api/auth/me — remediated status is preserved even after lock-off (option a per request). Admin still resolves to premium. test_preprod_entitlement_lock.py is now lock-state-aware — it uses a module-scoped fixture that reads the current lock via admin GET and branches assertions; tests marked with 'when_lock_active' skip when lock is off, and vice versa. If someone toggles the lock back ON, the same suite will still pass with the reverse skip pattern. SEO: seo.js runs as part of build.js and sync-rnw.js; sitemap has exactly 45 URLs (marketing + features/*, NO admin/auth). og-image.png=986KB served from /app/frontend/assets/og-image.png. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env = https://admin-policy-hub.preview.emergentagent.com.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All acceptance criteria pass. Lock-off flip and SEO injection are both production-ready. The prior test_preprod_entitlement_lock.py was rewritten (not just skipped) to be lock-state-aware so the same suite serves as regression whether the lock is ON or OFF in future.
